title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.11 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 11.11 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to make requests to internal network services via the repository import functionality due to insufficient validation of destination addresses. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
